name: node
grammar: grammar Composition { @package: guardcomposition @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Root,params=[value]) Root ::= Leaf @value; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= '😀' @text; }

name: enum
grammar: grammar Composition { @package: guardcomposition @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Root,params=[value]) Root ::= Mode @value; @enum Mode ::= 'auto' | 'sync'; }

name: mixed
grammar: grammar Composition { @package: guardcomposition @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Root,params=[value]) Root ::= Item @value; Item ::= Leaf | 'text'; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= '😀' @text; }

name: nested
grammar: grammar Composition { @package: guardcomposition @whitespace: none @root @nestedCaptures @mapping(Root,params=[value]) Root ::= '[' [ {Leaf} ] @value ']'; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= '😀' @text; }

name: family
grammar: grammar Composition { @package: guardcomposition @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Root,params=[value]) Root ::= Alias @value; @mapping(Family) @commonField(text) Alias ::= A | B; @mapping(Family.A,params=[text]) A ::= '😀' @text; @mapping(Family.B,params=[text]) B ::= 'x' @text; }

name: typeof-projection
grammar: grammar Composition { @package: guardcomposition @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Root,params=[value]) Root ::= Alias @value; @mapping(Family) @commonField(text) Alias ::= @typeof(value) A @value | @typeof(value) B @value; @mapping(Family.A,params=[text]) A ::= '😀' @text; @mapping(Family.B,params=[text]) B ::= 'x' @text; }

name: recovery-dag
grammar: grammar Composition { @package: guardcomposition @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Root) Root ::= 'ok'; @recovery(sync=';') Unused ::= 'x'; }
